Patient presents with high saturated fat, high calories, high sodium, and low protein/fiber.
summary: This menu features heavy frying, stir-frying, and high sodium options that exacerbate your current calorie, sodium, and saturated fat surpluses while failing to resolve your fiber and protein deficits. The best choices are clear, tangy broths containing whole fish or lean poultry which offer cardioprotective omega-3s and moderate sodium without oxidized frying fats.
